question: 'Nuakhai' is the state festival of:
solution:
The correct answer is __Odisha__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nuakhai or Navakhai is an agricultural festival mainly observed by people of Western Odisha and Southern Chhattisgarh in India.
 
• Nuakhai is observed to welcome the new rice of the season. 
 
• It will be celebrated on Thursday, 1 September 2022.
 
• The new harvest crops are worshipped and people celebrate it by eating the first rice of the harvest together with their families.
 
• Nuakhai Juhar is sharing gifts with your dear ones, wishing them on the occasion, and coming together as a family to symbolize unity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• some state festivals in India:
 
• Meghalaya
 
 
• The Wangala Festival, also known as the 100 Drums Festival, is a harvest festival that celebrates the end of a period of hard work and the good output of the fields.
 
• The festival honors Saljong, the Sun-god of fertility.
 
• Other festivals in Meghalaya include the Ahaia festival, Nongkrem Dance Festival, and Bob Dylan Festival. 
 
 
 
• Odisha
 
 
• The Ratha Yatra, or Chariot Festival, is a well-known religious festival that takes place in June-July.
 
• During the festival, Lord Jagannath and his siblings ride in a chariot to their aunt's home and return after a seven-day holiday.
 
• Other festivals in Odisha include Durga Puja, Saraswati Puja, Ganesh Puja, Shiva Ratri, Janmashtami, Kali Puja, and Kartik Puja. 
 
 
 
• Tamil Nadu
 
 
• Pongal is a major festival in Tamil Nadu, celebrated as a harvest festival in the Tamil month of Thai (mid-January to mid-February).
 
• Margazhi (Margali) is the Tamil month before Thai, spanning from mid-December to mid-January.
 
 
 
• Bihar
 
 
• Bihula is a prominent festival in eastern Bihar, especially in the district of Bhagalpur.
 
• It takes place in August, and devotees pray to Goddess Mansa for the welfare of their families
